description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon Bedrock Runtime Agents service, extending the AwsClient class and specifying available methods for operations like deleteAgentMemory, generateQuery, invokeAgent, and others.

classes.name: Aws edrockAgentRuntime edrockAgentRuntimeClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Bedrock Runtime Agent service, providing methods to interact with the service endpoints.

methods.name: deleteAgentMemory
methods.description: Deletes the memory of an agent in the Bedrock Runtime service.

methods.name: generateQuery
methods.description: Generates a query against the Bedrock Runtime service.

methods.name: getAgentMemory
methods.description: Retrieves the memory state of an agent.

methods.name: invokeAgent
methods.description: Invokes an agent with specified parameters.

methods.name: invokeFlow
methods.description: Invokes a flow in the Bedrock Runtime service.

methods.name: optimizePrompt
methods.description: Optimizes a prompt for the agent.

methods.name: rerank
methods.description: Re-ranks a set of results or data.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves information or data from the service.

methods.name: retrieveAndGenerate
methods.description: Retrieves data and generates content based on it.

methods.name: retrieveAndGenerateStream
methods.description: Streams retrieved data and generated content.
